profile_text.body:
Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited describes itself as the world's dedicated semiconductor foundry since 1987. In its own words, it supports an ecosystem of global customers and partners with process technology and a portfolio of design enablement solutions, and it says these efforts accelerate innovation in integrated circuit design and product applications. The company also states that it contributes to global IC innovation and to Taiwan's economy. It is a public company headquartered in Hsinchu, trading under the ticker TSM, and it is registered with the SEC under CIK 0001046179.

The site material does not name specific AI products or services. No AI products or MCP servers are tracked for the company, and no lawsuits involving it are recorded.
